Mod.Name: Off the Books: Station Economy Compatibility
Mod.Author: RnK Gaming
Mod.Description: Corrects faults in Station Economy, in memory: it keeps the phone (F7) inside the game's picture on a screen wider than 16:9, makes phone texts fit, fills in missing English and lets hoppers fill the Furnace. It changes prices: the whole-lot offer of Station Economy's crisis sellers becomes a discount, as the seller says. It changes none of Station Economy's files and writes nothing to saves. It comes with a table of English lines for Station Economy's texts, which that mod's author is free to take over. Requires Station Economy.
